guard: accepted goals survive native bearer expiry and missed progress without repeat submission, unbounded waits, foreign results or invented refusal provenance
why: A real Manager and signed user callout exercise a terminal after connection replacement and a canonical terminal recorded while renewal is deliberately held.
The gap observer reads the real goal-result command; it never proxies a private Manager store into the follower.
Compatibility views and malformed-result cases are explicit doubles. The compatibility counter observes actual spawn publishes using fetched real contracts.
The hanging read is released only after its deadline assertion. A late result's getters witness forbidden processing after completion.
Every mutant must finish all declared checks. Native flush and submission cancellation have their own goal-follow-cancellation fixture.

mutations.expectRed: STOP: settled in <200ms without waiting out deadline
mutations.cell: STOP: settled in <200ms without waiting out deadline

mutations.expectRed: COMPAT: exactly zero mutation submits occurred

    if (attributed.reply.ok !== true) return attributed;
